title: myrsine microphylla
intro: Myrsine microphylla, commonly known as New Caledonian boxwood or Akoka, is a plant species that belongs to the family Myrsinaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Myrsine microphylla include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, such as myrsinol and myrsineine, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
